decisions.sourceOwner: src/app/admin/users/page.tsx plus existing admin user routes/actions
decisions.reason: The remaining admin user actions render inside the selected-action workspace, not modal overlays. This pass removed modal-like shadow/chrome, shortened dev-facing copy, kept payment-proof language on balance changes, and preserved transaction history as a bounded last-30-record panel.

The admin page now renders the inline Drop action panel directly with presentation="inline". The panel owner carries the visible header, source marker, and validation state while creator/imported modal presentation stays untouched. Renaming or splitting the legacy component would affect creator imports and should be a separate low-risk consolidation.
